newsitem.title: USA: ITT Hartford files $1.25 bln shelf offering.
newsitem.headline: ITT Hartford files $1.25 bln shelf offering.

text.p: ITT Hartford Group Inc filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Wednesday for a shelf offering of up to $1.25 billion of debt securities, preferred stock, common stock, depositary shares, warrants, stock purchase contracts and stock purchase units.
The company said it also has available for sale up to $500 million in debt securities, preferred stock and depositary shares that were previously registered with the SEC.

Proceeds from the sale will be used for general corporate purposes, including working capital, capital expenditures, investments in or loans to subsidiaries, acquisitions and refinancing of debt, the company said.
The company did not name any underwriters for the offering.
